title: FATHER Future Lab — Prediction Method Pool

evidence_policy.SCIENTIFIC_A: primary peer-reviewed paper, standard, official scientific/engineering body or authoritative academic text
evidence_policy.SCIENTIFIC_B: replicated/accepted method documented by major technical reference
evidence_policy.EXPERIMENTAL: research method not yet qualified for product use
evidence_policy.NON_SCIENTIFIC: historical/cultural/divinatory system; never merged with scientific evidence score
